title: MariaDB Connector/J: Server could switch character_set_results away from UTF-8 without the client noticing…
description: MariaDB Connector/J versions 3.0.0 through before 3.3.7, 3.4.0 through before 3.4.5, and 3.5.0 through before 3.5.11 have a vulnerability where the connector does not properly guard against changes to the character_set_results session variable. This allows a malicious or compromised server to switch the character set away from UTF-8 without the client noticing, causing incorrect decoding of query results. This can lead to integrity issues where application-side validation or escaping based on string values can be bypassed. The vulnerability requires control of the server side of the connection and does not impact confidentiality or availability. Fixed versions are 3.3.7, 3.4.5, and 3.5.11.
